title: The influence of cell source on the senescence of human mesenchymal stem/stromal cells

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a review concerning cellular replicative senescence in human MSCs; multi-omics is not assessed because the report is nonempirical.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Cell source of human mesenchymal stem/stromal cells
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Replicative senescence patterns and related phenotype/function
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Differences in senescence-related characteristics by MSC source
